comment: Accepted-divergence registry for the per-ENGINE xdot tracks (circo/twopi/osage/patchwork/neato/fdp/sfdp — parity-<engine>.json, written by test/corpus/engine-walk.ts). Mirrors test/corpus/accepted-divergences.json's role for the dot SVG track, but keyed simply as engine -> id -> entry (no glob/engineIn selectors needed yet: every entry here is a specific corpus id already root-caused for that one engine). Joined at report-time by test/corpus/parity-report.ts into PARITY-<engine>.md (accepted deltas pulled out of the Diverged table, counted separately in Summary) and into the cross-engine PARITY.md track row. An accepted entry is a deliberate, documented, won't-fix difference; everything non-conformant NOT listed here is an unaccepted tracked gap. Adding/removing an entry must be paired with prose in docs/known-divergences.md. Two shapes share this registry (see plans/iterative-parity-campaign/decisions.md#D2): per-id { class: string, bound?, ref } (hand-root-caused, one row per id, as above), and CLASS { class: true, attributionFile, ref } (neato/fdp/sfdp A1-drift below) — class membership is COMPUTED at report time from attribution-<engine>.json's drift-exonerated verdicts, never hand-enumerated; an id that starts passing outright leaves the class silently on the next report regen. A per-id entry may also accept a FAULT row: { verdict: 'port-error' | 'timeout', errIncludes } (errIncludes required for port-error, a case-sensitive substring of the row's err) accepts a matching port-error/timeout row instead of a diverged one (plans/registry-faults-staleness/decisions.md AD-1); test/corpus/registry-staleness.test.ts fails when a per-id entry no longer matches its committed walk row.

tree-graphs-directed-oldarrows.bound: 40 draw-op diffs confined to the mirrored radial edge pair Z->I / i->Z, which swap straight (8-coord) vs routed (14-coord) splines; node positions and every other edge conformant. Injection A/B 2026-07-28: oracle pre-routing ND_pos injected into the port -> 0 diffs, routing/emission exonerated (attribution-twopi.json). Refined flip site: with i-Z-I collinear on a ring diameter, pathplan directVis's intersect() treats the segment as blocked when a third node's axis vertex x falls strictly inside the ULP-wide (tail.x, head.x) interval (wind's 1e-4 tolerance makes 270pt-distant vertices 'collinear', and inBetween then tests ONLY the x projection) - so the straight/curved choice per side hinges on the last-ULP ordering of three nominally equal x coordinates out of PRISM's solve. Verified by replicating directVis offline on both sides' dumped obstacle sets: each reproduces its own side's decision exactly.

Mechanism: with circpos.c's fma contraction and evaluation order mirrored, 31/32 pre-adjust positions are bit-exact; node 22 differs by 1 ULP because V8 and Apple libm round cos/sin differently at 3 positionChildren angles (cos 0x1.c7bd892b3aa91p+1, sin 0x1.fd5b5d123280bp+1, cos 0x1.0c152382d7364p+2). PRISM's Delaunay then flips one near-cocircular diagonal on the mirror axis (prism iteration 1: edge 15-17 vs 16-18). Injection A/B: native cos/sin fed to the port -> every pre-adjust position bit-exact, 0 diffs; V8 cos/sin fed to the native build -> the oracle's layout in 22/30 runs, the port's in 8/30 (GTS edge order depends on allocation addresses).

tree-graphs-directed-polypoly.bound: Rigid pack-cell re-order of the 9000-series distorted quads (112 draw-op diffs; 10 of 76 nodes move, the rest bit-identical; 9002/9006 swap cells with -(2739,176)/+(2449,176) translations, 8 neighbours shift in x only; no shape/routing error). Mechanism: the SAME node-9004 cos(pi+theta) 1-ULP as graphs-polypoly (C bb.x 57.754149262393340791 vs port 57.754149262393326580 - byte-identical to the patchwork-tail RCA values). Propagation on this larger input is osage arrayRects acmpf, which sorts by the RAW width+height sum: under Apple libm 9004's key is strictly 1 ULP above its rotated siblings 9000/9002/9006 and sorts first; under V8's correctly-rounded cos the four keys tie exactly and unstable qsort orders the group differently -> different row-major 9x9 cells -> the 9002/9006 swap plus a column-width fmax cascade. Reproduced exactly by feeding the port's own arrayRects the C sizes vs the port sizes (10 place diffs, dx byte-matching the sweep). Irreducible per the A9 controlled experiment (bare transcendental, bit-identical argument). osage only; same input passes the other engines.

graphs-polypoly.bound: Rigid pack-cell swap of the 9000-series distorted-quad components (whole-node ±(182,338)/±2909 translations; <=24 draw-op diffs per id, no shape/routing error). Mechanism: bare transcendental cos(pi+theta) — V8 Math.cos is correctly rounded while Apple libm's cos carries a 1-ULP argument-dependent error, so |cos(pi+theta)| != |cos(theta)| only under libm; the 1-ULP size delta feeds pack GRID ceil, tips a perimeter tie, and qsort swaps two components' cells. No deterministic rewrite reproduces a non-correctly-rounded libm transcendental. osage only. Full RCA: .agent-notes/patchwork-tail-rca.md.
